verdict.rationale: Featurebase's marketing copy says changelogs can be served from a standalone page where you can "Subscribe users to email updates." It also says releases can be segmented by user attributes to send targeted release notes. Together these cover the core story of customers subscribing to email updates for new changelog entries. missing for 10: in-depth docs on the subscription flow (customer self-subscribe UI, trigger on publish, unsubscribe and email settings), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing claims.
